# Repository Initialization

The `init_repository` function sets up a new repository for the Knowledge Compiler. It performs necessary database schema migrations, writes a configuration file (`kc.toml`), and registers the repository in the system, ensuring all components are properly configured for use.

- `knowledge_compiler/compiler/bootstrap.py` — `knowledge_compiler.compiler.bootstrap.init_repository`
